additional_info.subject: ID0456882-DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / PD 170001231] Faulted plug CRM:03056000254
additional_info.body:
Hi Chlöe, good morning. I hope you are doing well.
I apologise for the wrong assessment by the colleague. QA35 is not even related to DC2 but DC1 and DC4.
I will provide you some troubleshooting steps to follow:
Check if this connector is properly attached, my opinion is (shutdown the charger) to remove this connectors apart and reconnect them again, you need to open the converter plate, specially this terminal 3 since it's the one giving error:
Check the 12V coming in and out of the KF13:
Check the LED of the QA32-35, if they are all lighting up when FSC (fast shutdown check) is happening.
If everything else fails, please try replacing KF13.
Let me know your feedback.
Thanks and have a lovely holiday season.
Best regards,
Francisco
